summary: Frontend E2E test of the new editable Teacher Profile feature (9 scenarios) plus calendar-month regression check. Modal opens from both entry points, all 7 fields are editable and the modal closes on save/cancel/X. HOWEVER the saved teacher profile does NOT persist: it is visibly reverted to the seed values within ~1.2s of saving. Root cause found and confirmed with direct API calls - the backend AppState Pydantic model has no `teacher` field and uses extra='ignore', so PUT/GET /api/state silently strips the teacher object, and the 1200ms polling loop in App.js overwrites local state with the stripped server copy. Steps 4, 5 and 7 of the requested test plan FAIL. Also confirmed the calendar month/day header CSS fix was written with the wrong selector and is still broken.

critical.issue: AppState model (backend/server.py:40-49) has no `teacher` field and model_config uses extra='ignore', so the teacher object sent by the frontend is silently dropped. Verified: PUT with {"teacher":{...},"sessions":[{"id":"s1"}]} returns and stores a body with no `teacher` key. Teacher profile edits can never persist. Add `teacher: Dict[str, Any] = {}` (or a TeacherProfile model) to AppState.

ui_bugs.issue: App.css rule was written as `.calendar-month .week-head` (descendant) but the DOM element is `<div class='week-head calendar-month'>` (same element), so the fix never applies. Computed: month header = 5 columns (178px x5) while the grid below = 7 columns; header labels wrap to a 2nd row (Jun 20/Jun 21) and are misaligned with the day columns. Day view is equally misaligned (header 5 cols vs grid 1fr). Fix: use `.week-head.calendar-month,.calendar-grid.calendar-month{grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr)}` and `.week-head.calendar-day,.calendar-grid.calendar-day{grid-template-columns:1fr}`. Note the existing rules `.week-head,.calendar-grid.calendar-day{...}` and `.week-head,.calendar-grid.calendar-month{...}` incorrectly target ALL .week-head elements via the bare comma selector.

Clearing First name (or Last name) and clicking Save silently does nothing - `commit()` returns early with no inline error and the modal stays open with no feedback. Add a visible validation message (e.g. data-testid='teacher-profile-error').
Copy is hardcoded 'Nice pace, Alex. Keep the rhythm.' (DashboardV2 and Dashboard). After renaming the teacher to Priya the dashboard still says 'Alex'. Should use teacher.firstName.

integration_issues.issue: Immediately after save the sidebar shows 'Priya Kapoor / Senior Mathematics Teacher' and greeting 'Good morning, Priya' (correct), but ~1.2s later the 1200ms polling useEffect (App.js line 19) replaces state with the server response, which has no `teacher` key, so `state.teacher||seed.teacher` falls back to seed and the UI reverts to 'Alex Morgan / Teacher workspace'. Reopening the modal via the topbar shows Alex/Teacher workspace again, and a page reload also shows Alex. Requires the backend AppState fix; additionally consider merging the polled response instead of wholesale replace so in-flight local edits are not clobbered.

issues: Layout, spacing and contrast are good; no issues found.
Day-of-week header row wraps onto a second line and is not aligned with the 7 day columns below (see CSS selector bug above).

action_items: CRITICAL: add `teacher` to the backend AppState model in /app/backend/server.py (e.g. `teacher: Dict[str, Any] = {}`) so PUT/GET /api/state stop stripping it.
Re-verify persistence after the backend fix: save profile, wait >2s (past the poll), reopen modal, and hard-reload.
Fix App.css calendar selectors: `.week-head.calendar-month` / `.week-head.calendar-day` (not descendant), and remove the bare `.week-head` from those comma-separated rules.
Add a visible validation error in TeacherProfileModal when first/last name is blank.
Replace hardcoded 'Nice pace, Alex' with teacher.firstName in the dashboard progress panel.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py AppState uses extra='ignore' - any new client-side state slice must be declared explicitly or it is silently discarded. This is the exact failure mode here; consider extra='allow' or an explicit teacher model.

App.js line 19 polls GET /api/state every 1200ms and calls setState(r.data) wholesale. This will clobber any local edit whose PUT has not completed/round-tripped, and makes any un-modelled field impossible to keep. Poll interval of 1.2s is also unnecessarily aggressive for a single-user app.
App.js line 14: `teacher.firstName[0]` will throw if teacher.firstName is undefined (e.g. a persisted teacher object missing a key). Use optional chaining.

success_rate.backend: not in scope (1 model defect found)

seed_data_creation: Deleted the app_state document in Mongo once to reset corrupted state created during API probing; app now falls back to in-code seed. No other data created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Passed: initial sidebar/greeting values, modal opens from sidebar & topbar testids, all 7 inputs prefilled and editable, save closes modal, cancel and X close without applying changes, nav smoke test across Dashboard/Calendar/Students/Subjects/Session with zero console or page errors. Failed: post-save persistence (reverts in ~1.2s), reopened-modal values, reload persistence, avatar image never renders (avatarUrl lost with the rest of the teacher object so initials 'AM' show). Retest steps 4/5/7 after the backend AppState `teacher` field is added, and re-check the month/day calendar header column alignment via getComputedStyle on .week-head.
rca_of_the_issue: The frontend correctly sends {...state, teacher} to PUT /api/state, but FastAPI validates the body against AppState which declares only subjects/students/sessions/lessons/attendance/assignments/grades/notes with model_config ConfigDict(extra='ignore'). The teacher key is therefore dropped before the Mongo replace_one, and GET /api/state (also response_model=AppState) never returns it. Because App.js re-fetches GET /api/state every 1200ms and does setState(r.data) unconditionally, the freshly saved in-memory teacher object is replaced by a server payload with no teacher, and `state.teacher||seed.teacher` falls back to the hardcoded seed. Reproduction: open app -> sidebar profile -> set first name Priya -> Save -> sidebar briefly shows 'Priya Kapoor' then reverts to 'Alex Morgan' within ~1.2s. Mitigation: declare teacher on AppState (and optionally switch the poll to a merge instead of a full replace).
